entries.hades.saveEditor.title: Save Editor
entries.hades.saveEditor.readConfirm: Reading this source discards the current pending changes.
entries.hades.saveEditor.noSources: No Hades saves are available. Refresh the file list.
entries.hades.saveEditor.key: Typed JSON for the Lua Key
entries.hades.saveEditor.advancedWarning: Direct editing changes saved data. The native impact of unrecognized fields is unknown.
entries.hades.saveEditor.typedHelp: Use JSON preserving Lua types: luaType is nil, boolean, number, string or table. Tables retain arraySize, hashSize and entries containing key and value. Byte strings use encoding: base64; raw doubles use encoding: ieee754. Completed valid input enters Changes.
entries.hades.saveEditor.invalidValue: Invalid input. Correct the number or typed Lua JSON, then finish editing again.
entries.hades.saveEditor.invalidResponse: The editor response is incompatible. Read the source again; current changes remain available.
entries.hades.saveEditor.recovery: This write retained recovery evidence. Preserve the copy below and inspect it through Save Management before recovery. Do not repeat this Apply.
entries.hades.saveEditor.hot: Disk replacement is verified. The running game has not reloaded this data; a later game save may overwrite it.
entries.hades.saveEditor.loadInGame: Load the target save in the game to use these changes.
entries.hades.fishingHelp: Generates once in an eligible room with a native fishing point. Fishing, catch records and turn-in follow the native flow.
entries.hades.fishing.unavailable.scene: Requires an actionable chamber in the current run.
entries.hades.fishing.unavailable.room: This chamber has no eligible native fishing point, or one already appeared, was used or was generated.
entries.hades.chaosGateHelp: Generates once where native eligibility and entrance points permit it. Entry retains the native health cost and room flow.
entries.hades.shortcut.unavailable: This hotkey is unavailable in the current state.
entries.hades.occurrence.title: Specify Encounter
entries.hades.noReadyDoors: Exit rewards and destinations are available when the room exits are ready.
entries.hades.doorHelp: Changes the selected exit; enter it normally in the game. Old actions expire when the room changes.
entries.hades.thanatosPending: Schedules a Thanatos encounter through this exit while preserving native eligibility.
entries.hades.error.staleRoom: The room changed. Refresh and select the action again.
entries.hades.error.staleDoor: The exit changed. Refresh and select it again.
entries.hades.error.worldUnavailable: The native requirements are not met. Choose an eligible room or exit.
entries.hades.routeScheduled: The exit encounter is scheduled; native eligibility is checked on entry.
entries.hades.waitingForHero: Enter the game to observe the current hero.
entries.hades.connectionHelp: Supports the local Hades Steam build through Rosetta.
entries.hades.invincibilityHelp: Keeps protection across rooms and preserves native protection.
entries.hades.error.ambiguousTarget: Multiple Hades processes found. Keep one running and retry.
entries.hades.input.invalid: Invalid value. The current value has been restored.
entries.hades.input.unavailable: This edit cannot be applied now. The current value has been restored.
entries.hades.error.unknownCommand: This module does not support this action.
entries.hades.error.heroNotReady: No hero is ready. Enter the game and refresh.
entries.hades.error.unsupportedRuntime: The current hero state is incompatible. No change was made.
entries.hades.error.unsupportedBuild: This Hades image is unsupported. No change was made.
entries.hades.error.attachDenied: The system denied attaching to Hades. Check debugger access and reconnect.
entries.hades.error.debuggerStart: Unable to start the debugger. Check Xcode command line tools.
entries.hades.error.debuggerLost: Debugger connection lost. Restart the backend and reconnect.
entries.hades.error.debuggerProtocol: Incompatible debugger reply; the outcome is unknown. Restart the game and backend before reconnecting.
entries.hades.error.debuggerCall: Unable to read game state. Refresh or reconnect.
entries.hades.error.outcomeUnknown: The operation outcome is unknown and was not retried. Inspect and restart the game before reconnecting.
entries.hades.error.luaInterrupted: The debugger interrupted game execution. The game was force quit to prevent further save corruption; unsaved progress was lost. Relaunch the game and reconnect.
entries.hades.error.luaTerminationFailed: Game execution was interrupted, but Force Quit could not be confirmed. Force Quit the game immediately in Activity Monitor before it continues or saves, then relaunch.
entries.hades.error.restartRequired: Restart the game before reconnecting to this runtime.
entries.hades.error.stopTimeout: Timed out waiting for the game to stop. Reconnect.
entries.hades.error.resumeFailed: The game has not resumed. Keep connected and retry disconnecting.
entries.hades.error.restoreFailed: The background focus setting has not been restored. Keep connected and retry disconnecting.
entries.hades.error.unexpectedStop: The game stopped unexpectedly. The current change was not executed.
entries.hades.error.runtimeNotReady: Game scripts are not ready. Refresh when the game is ready.
entries.hades.error.detachFailed: The debugger is still attached. Retry disconnecting.
entries.hades.acquisition.gameControlledHint: This target does not accept a specified rarity.
entries.hades.profile.name: Configuration Name
entries.hades.profile.empty: No custom configurations yet. Saved configurations appear here.
entries.hades.profile.explanation: Save and apply Hades continuous feature settings, game speed, and shortcuts. Settings applied while disconnected take effect on the next connection; older profiles without shortcuts keep existing bindings unchanged.
entries.hades.profile.pending: Profile saved as desired settings. Connect Hades to apply them.
entries.hades.error.profileInvalid: Use a profile name of 1–64 visible characters without path separators.
entries.hades.error.profileReadFailed: Unable to read this Hades feature profile. Check its file or select another profile.
entries.hades.error.profileWriteFailed: Unable to save or delete the feature profile. Check storage and access permissions.
entries.hades.error.profileNewerFormat: This feature profile uses a newer data format and was left unchanged. Update the Trainer to use or replace it.
entries.hades.error.profileShortcutLayoutUnsuppo: This Profile uses unsupported shortcut layout version {0}. Its other settings were loaded; existing shortcuts were left unchanged.
entries.hades.diagnostics.explanation: Shows current connection and hero observations, desired settings, and the supported game image. Export includes this observation and current Trainer logs.
entries.hades.disableAllPending: Settings reset. Reconnect or restart the game to clear in-game effects.
entries.hades.fullHealthHelp: Keeps the current hero at maximum life during damage resolution while preserving native damage records.
entries.hades.infiniteAmmoHelp: Refills native ammo after use while preserving stored Casts, loading, drops and pickups.
entries.hades.forceRerollsHelp: Enables rerolls on newly built boon, shop, purge menus and exits. Preserves blocked offers, costs and door eligibility without changing Mirror selections.
entries.hades.boonRarityHelp: New or rerolled Olympian and Hermes offers meet the selected minimum rarity while preserving native higher-tier odds, eligible Legendary rolls, native availability and Force Common. Chaos, Hammers and existing offers are unchanged.
entries.hades.emptyTraits: No boons on the current hero.
entries.hades.noConsumptionHelp: Keeps gains while purchases and use follow their native flow.
entries.hades.limitation.duplicateName: These same-name effects have different rarities or owners and cannot be managed as one boon.
entries.hades.limitation.specialOwner: This effect has a dedicated native owner.
entries.hades.limitation.specialLifecycle: Manage this effect with its native expiry or removal actions below.
entries.hades.limitation.unknownTrait: No verified effect definition exists in this game.
entries.hades.error.recoveryFailed: Unable to read or write the native-operation recovery record. Restart the game, then check the trainer data directory.
entries.hades.fullGodGaugeHelp: Keeps the gauge full when an Aid is available and preserves its native duration.
entries.hades.error.staleTarget: The hero changed. Refresh and enter the value again.
entries.hades.error.preferencesFailed: Unable to save trainer settings. Check disk space and directory permissions, then retry.
entries.hades.error.preferencesReadFailed: Unable to read saved trainer settings. Check the settings file, or load a custom profile to replace them.
entries.hades.error.preferencesNewerFormat: Trainer settings use a newer data format and were left unchanged. Update the Trainer to use them.
entries.hades.error.staleHero: The hero changed. Refresh and enter the value again.
entries.hades.error.staleTrait: The selected boon changed. Refresh and select it again.
entries.hades.error.unsupportedTrait: This boon’s native lifecycle does not support this action.
entries.hades.error.traitWeaponRequired: Equip the weapon required by this boon.
entries.hades.error.traitSlotOccupied: A different boon occupies this slot. Remove or replace it in the game first.
entries.hades.error.preferenceWrite: Unable to save trainer settings. Try again.
entries.hades.error.catalog: Unable to read the boon catalog. Restart the backend.
entries.hades.error.protocol: The backend state is incompatible. Restart the backend.
entries.hades.catalogHelp: Acquires the selected boon with its native weapon and slot requirements.
entries.hades.equipmentAcquireHelp: Keepsakes and Companions replace the equipped item and save progression for the selected rarity.
